description: List all organizations available to the current user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a list of organizations and pagination info; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single organization by its id.

org_id.description: The unique id of the organization.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the organization object; on failure (organization not found), output contains an error message.

description: List events for a given organization, optionally filtered by status and a search query.

org_id.description: The unique id of the organization whose events to list.

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. draft, live, completed, canceled).

q.description: Optional search query matched against event name and summary.

page_size.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the serialized events and pagination info; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Search events across all organizations, optionally filtered by query and status.

q.description: Optional search query matched against event name and summary.

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. draft, live, completed, canceled).

page_size.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the serialized events and pagination info; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single event by its id.

event_id.description: The unique id of the event.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized event; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new draft event for an organization.

organization_id.description: The id of the organization the event belongs to.

summary.description: A short summary of the event.

start_utc.description: Event start time in UTC ISO format.

end_utc.description: Event end time in UTC ISO format.

venue_id.description: Optional venue id where the event is held.

is_free.description: Whether the event is free (default true).

online_event.description: Whether the event is online (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized created event; on failure (organization not found), output contains an error message.

description: Publish an event, moving it to live status (requires at least one ticket class).

event_id.description: The unique id of the event to publish.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized live event; on failure (event not found or no ticket class), output contains an error message.

description: Cancel an event, moving it to canceled status.

event_id.description: The unique id of the event to cancel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized canceled event; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a list of venue objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single venue by its id.

venue_id.description: The unique id of the venue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the venue object; on failure (venue not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the ticket classes belonging to an event.

event_id.description: The unique id of the event.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a list of ticket class objects; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new ticket class for an event.

event_id.description: The unique id of the event the ticket class belongs to.

name.description: The name of the ticket class.

quantity_total.description: The total number of tickets available for this class.

cost.description: The cost of the ticket in minor units (default 0).

free.description: Whether the ticket class is free (default true).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created ticket class; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: List attendees of an event, optionally filtered by status and check-in state.

event_id.description: The unique id of the event.

checked_in.description: Optional check-in filter; when set, only attendees matching this checked-in state are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains a list of attendees and pagination info; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Register a new attendee for an event against a ticket class.

event_id.description: The unique id of the event to register for.

ticket_class_id.description: The id of the ticket class to register against.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created attendee; on failure (event/ticket class not found or sold out), output contains an error message.

description: Check in an attendee by their id.

attendee_id.description: The unique id of the attendee to check in.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated attendee; on failure (attendee not found), output contains an error message.
